name: Submission
overview: Scripture reveals submission as a profound act of aligning one’s will with God's sovereign plan, exemplified supremely in Jesus’ prayers in Matthew, Mark, and Luke where He submits to the Father’s will despite personal cost. This submission is not passive but a conscious surrender, recognizing God’s authority over all things. Additionally, the carnal mind’s natural resistance to God's law, as stated in Romans, highlights the spiritual challenge and necessity of submission. Paul’s acknowledgment in 1 Corinthians that his plans depend on the Lord’s permission further underscores the believer’s posture of submission to divine authority.
